rapport_notes: Professional, thorough, and script-sharp -- used a helpful reference point and patiently resolved every question raised.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "I'd like to ask first what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Fully resolved the pricing-structure concern, then kept digging as new concerns surfaced (bed frame disposal, elevator reservation timing) until each was closed out
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "this is just an estimate. We are a time based company so you will be charged for the total time consumed by the end of the move"

top_strength: Opened with a textbook quid pro quo plus agenda ask straight from the script, then thoroughly resolved multiple concerns (pricing, disposal, elevator timing) before building a fully personalized time estimate and asking for the close.
coaching_note: On-Time Guarantee was never explicitly named in the call -- worth saying 'on-time guarantee' by name so the customer connects the arrival-window commitment to a named benefit.
